verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of bulk capability is Cake's bulk upload tools for importing spreadsheet cap-table data (docs-17). The AI/MCP integration is explicitly read-only (docs-27), and no public API/OpenAPI spec was found (probe-2), so AI-driven bulk mutations aren't supported. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete actions across many grants or stakeholders, any write-capable API or MCP tools for batch operations, and independent corroboration.
